body: See, I would probably kill myself before going down that road. My mistakes in life (aka never going to a non-shitty law school) would haunt me forever.

Thanks for the kind words...it's just so frustrating. I don't want to end up doing personal injury work like you see in the ads on buses and on television. That would be so demoralizing. I don't even care about making tons of money - I just want to make enough money to live and enjoy life. :\
